visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a grey top and silver earrings, smiles and talks directly to the camera. The background is a cream-colored graphic featuring the Costco logo and floating illustrations of vegetables like tomatoes and blueberries. (2) The visual shifts to a close-up of a black pan on a white induction stove. Hands use a spatula to stir-fry green brussels sprouts, sliced carrots, and beef chunks. The lighting is bright and direct. (3) The woman is seen in a kitchen setting, holding fresh green kale leaves and placing them into a red blender jar. A transition follows, showing a deep purple fruit juice being poured into a clear glass decorated with colorful cartoon characters. (4) The woman holds a large, vacuum-sealed block of raw marbled beef close to her face. A subsequent shot shows a white ceramic pot filled with a bubbling brown beef stew containing carrots and potatoes, into which a bowl of marrow balls is emptied. (5) Hands pour a clear liquid from a glass bottle into Ziploc bags containing raw chicken wings. A brief black-and-white filter is applied as the woman poses with a slightly distressed facial expression near bottles of condiments. (6) A close-up reveals a bowl of shredded chicken, cabbage, and mushrooms. A young boy with black hair is shown taking a large, enthusiastic bite of a chicken wing, with stylized pink heart graphics appearing around him.
